primary_source: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)

rules.reason: Beta-blockers can precipitate severe bronchospasm in patients with asthma.

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: Do not use beta blockers in asthmatics and heart failure

rules.reason: Timolol eye drops are absorbed systemically and are contraindicated in asthma and heart block.

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: Timoptol is contraindicated in Asthmatics and patients with heart block

rules.reason: NSAIDs cause gastrointestinal bleeding and must not be given in peptic ulcer disease.

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: Aspirin and other NSAIDs ... Do not prescribe for patients with peptic ulcer disease

rules.reason: ACE inhibitors and ARBs are teratogenic.

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: ACEI and ARB are teratogenic, contraindicated in pregnancy

rules.reason: Warfarin is teratogenic; heparin is the safer anticoagulant in pregnancy.

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: Heparin safer in pregnancy; warfarin is teratogenic

rules.reason: Valproate carries a risk of spina bifida in the foetus.

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: Valproate is contraindicated in pregnant women because of risk of spina bifida

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)

rules.reason: Tetracyclines deposit in growing bone and teeth of the foetus.

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: Tetracyclines, and doxycycline are contraindicated in pregnancy and in children less than 12 years

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: Ciprofloxacin is contraindicated in growing adolescents and children below 12 years; also contraindicated in pregnancy

rules.reason: Methotrexate is contraindicated in pregnancy and breastfeeding.

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: Methotrexate: ... Contraindicated in pregnancy and breast feeding

rules.reason: Metformin and long-acting sulphonylureas must be avoided in poor kidney or liver function.

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: Avoid metformin and long-acting sulphonylureas such as glibenclamide in individuals with poor kidney and liver function

rules.reason: Tetracyclines (except doxycycline) may worsen renal failure.

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: With the exception of doxycycline, tetracyclines may exacerbate renal failure and should not be given to patients with kidney disease

rules.reason: Anticholinergic drugs are contraindicated in glaucoma and prostatic enlargement.

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: Anticholinergic drugs ... Their use is contraindicated in the presence of glaucoma and prostatic enlargement

rules.reason: Acetazolamide is contraindicated in sickle cell disease.

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: Acetazolamide is contraindicated in patients with pre-existing systemic acidosis, patients with sickle cell disease and allergy to sulphonamides

rules.reason: Efavirenz causes neuropsychiatric effects and is contraindicated where psychiatric illness already exists.

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: EFV is contraindicated in patients who already have psychiatric manifestations

rules.reason: Combining an ACE inhibitor with an ARB raises the risk of hyperkalaemia, hypotension and renal impairment.

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: There is increased risk of hyperkalaemia, hypotension, and impaired renal function when angiotensin-II receptor antagonists are taken with ACE Inhibitors

rules.reason: Potassium supplements with potassium-sparing diuretics cause hyperkalaemia.

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: Unless there is a compelling indication, do not combine potassium supplements with potassium-sparing drugs

rules.reason: These medicines lower dolutegravir levels and risk HIV treatment failure.

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: Avoid co-administration of DTG with carbamazepine, nevirapine, phenytoin, phenobarbitone, rifampicin, dofetilide

rules.reason: Heparin should not be given together with streptokinase (bleeding risk).

source.document: Nigeria Standard Treatment Guidelines, 3rd ed. (Federal Ministry of Health, 2022)
source.statement: Heparin should not be given with streptokinase
